blocks.html: In celebration of the PRC Week from June 16 to 21, the Philippine Regulatory Commission is pleased to announce that it will conduct two major activities at selected Robinsons Malls. In Robinsons Galleria Cebu, PRC will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony for the opening of the new PRC Service Center at Level 3 on June 16. The event will be graced by PRC’s Chairman, Mr. Teofilo S. Pilando Jr. A culminating activity will be held at Robinsons Place Manila on Wednesday, June 21 where PRC officials and members of the press will be in attendance. An AVP presentation regarding the new PRC Service Centers in Robinsons Malls will be presented on this date. Currently, there are already 8 new PRC Service Centers operational in different Robinsons Malls including Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Gensan, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Butuan and Robinsons Galleria Cebu. Later this year, 2 more PRC Service Centers will open at Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Ormoc. Likewise, 10 more PRC Service Centers are expected to begin its operations within a year at Robinsons Place Tagum, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, and Robinsons Novaliches.
